reason: Repaired the cocycle check using the fibrewise-density criterion justified by a finite prime filtration of the Noetherian base: smoothness gives flatness and geometrically reduced fibres, associated primes of the total space are generic points of fibre components, and a fibre-dense open meets each such point. Flat pullback then preserves schematic density by finite principal-open Cech equalizers and flat tensoring, including on X′×_X X′. Separately proved f quasi-compact and locally finitely presented from finite-type charts over affine Noetherian opens, Noetherianity, and finite-type-algebra presentations. The original faithfully-flat descent statement is unchanged.
